admission.justification: A selection failure here would show a dead frame or an invented Architect while the developer asked for the architect/projects pane when nothing is selected; the backend read is guarded by its focused tests.

applicability: The Operations right rail with no task document selected and no current exact launched request for that selection.
conditions: Absent a current exact launched-request agent, the frame opens the Projects workspace on the tab of the last-started recorded Architect the host still holds and has not archived.

A current exact launched request from the bound row or an exact Projects start is shown instead of the default until the selection changes or that exact target is gone or archived; the default then applies again.
With no matching agent the panel offers the bound Projects launcher instead of a dead frame.
The host's read-only state decides existence and archival; a record alone is never shown as live.
exclusions: Several Architects are reached through the host's own tabs; only the newest is selected.
The developer has not ruled on which Architect should win when there are several.
No actor-selection code, multiple-Architect policy or exact-request reconciliation is changed by this scope.
